manualAudit.method: Fresh deterministic stratified sample from the completed run: one automated PASS per family and one automated FAIL per family where a failure existed; adversarial review for clinical correctness, safety, source boundary, numerical consistency and SBA integrity.

sampledPasses.note: Current NICE NG196 recommendation 1.8.8 still supports heparin at initial presentation in new-onset AF when not therapeutically anticoagulated and no contraindication.

Automated PASS treated no history/no vaccine as established susceptibility and omitted the decision-critical PEP timing. UKHSA guidance updated 19 March 2026 requires urgent VZV antibody assessment when history/vaccination do not establish immunity; for a susceptible pregnant woman oral aciclovir/valaciclovir is given from day 7 to day 14 after first exposure. PASS therefore did not mean publishable.

sampledFailures.note: Keyed fibrinolysis while explanation correctly says PCI is preferred within the stated 90-minute transfer window; internal key/explanation contradiction.
Precomputed named clinical scores in vignette; preserve numerical guard.
Nested oxygen-threshold options create multiple defensible answers.
Timing since exposure insufficient for the decision-critical antiviral schedule.
Named CURB-65 total asserted; this family also showed arithmetic-risk examples, so numerical verification guard must remain strict.

manualAudit.passPrecisionConclusion: Automated PASS is not yet equivalent to publishable. Highest-priority genuine defect is an incomplete/stale varicella-in-pregnancy evidence boundary, not reviewer strictness.

highestLeverageDefect.description: Varicella PEP packet collapses susceptibility and omits exact timing, allowing clinically incomplete PASSes.
highestLeverageDefect.requiredFix: Require immunity/susceptibility assessment, significant exposure definition/timing, and day-7-to-day-14 oral antiviral schedule; VZIG/IVIG only when oral antivirals cannot be used per current UKHSA guidance. Do not weaken any quality gate.

sourcesChecked: UKHSA Guidelines on post-exposure prophylaxis for varicella or shingles, updated 19 March 2026
